description:
How to use HeritageDeed's key-authenticated REST API (v1) instead of, or next to, this MCP server: base URL,
        how to get a free API key, authentication, endpoints, the live list of report types you can order, limits,
        signed webhooks, idempotency, batches (JSON or CSV) and the white-label PDF option. Use it when a developer
        wants to integrate title searches (O&E reports), lien and encumbrance checks or environmental records reports
        into their own software, or asks for an API key. This MCP server itself needs no key.
name: rest_api_info
